mapper.sql: e.id, e.order_id, o.order_no, o.store_id, s.store_name, e.user_id, u.username, u.real_name AS customer_name, u.phone AS customer_phone, e.vehicle_id, CONCAT(COALESCE(b.brand_name, ''), ' ', COALESCE(m.model_name, '')) AS vehicle_name, v.license_plate, e.rating, e.vehicle_rating, e.store_rating, e.content, e.images, e.reply, e.reply_time, e.status, e.create_time

FROM order_evaluation e LEFT JOIN lease_order o ON o.id = e.order_id LEFT JOIN store s ON s.id = o.store_id AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = e.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN vehicle v ON v.id = e.vehicle_id AND v.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN vehicle_model m ON m.id = v.model_id LEFT JOIN vehicle_brand b ON b.id = m.brand_id
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE e.order_id = #{orderId} AND e.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(e.rating), 0), 2) AS avg_rating, ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(e.vehicle_rating), 0), 2) AS avg_vehicle_rating, ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(e.store_rating), 0), 2) AS avg_store_rating, COALESCE(SUM(e.rating = 5), 0) AS five_star, COALESCE(SUM(e.rating = 4), 0) AS four_star, COALESCE(SUM(e.rating <= 3), 0) AS low_star, COALESCE(SUM(e.reply IS NOT NULL AND e.reply <> ''), 0) AS replied, COALESCE(SUM(e.reply IS NULL OR e.reply = ''), 0) AS unreplied FROM order_evaluation e LEFT JOIN lease_order o ON o.id = e.order_id WHERE e.deleted = 0
AND o.store_id = #{storeId}

SELECT e.id, CONCAT( LEFT(COALESCE(NULLIF(u.real_name, ''), u.username, '匿名用户'), 1), '**' ) AS customer_name, e.rating, e.vehicle_rating, e.store_rating, e.content, e.images, e.reply, e.reply_time, e.create_time FROM order_evaluation e LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = e.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE e.vehicle_id = #{vehicleId} AND e.deleted = 0 AND e.status = 1 ORDER BY e.create_time DESC, e.id DESC

SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(e.rating), 0), 1) AS avg_rating, ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(e.vehicle_rating), 0), 1) AS avg_vehicle_rating, ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(e.store_rating), 0), 1) AS avg_store_rating, COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(e.rating = 5), 0) AS star5, COALESCE(SUM(e.rating = 4), 0) AS star4, COALESCE(SUM(e.rating = 3), 0) AS star3, COALESCE(SUM(e.rating = 2), 0) AS star2, COALESCE(SUM(e.rating = 1), 0) AS star1 FROM order_evaluation e WHERE e.vehicle_id = #{vehicleId} AND e.deleted = 0 AND e.status = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_evaluation WHERE order_id = #{orderId}

#{oid}
